dct_description_sm: This dataset contains X-ray microtomography and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) images of five sandstone samples, including Berea, Buff Berea, Castlegate, Bentheimer, and Nugget, and one carbonate sample, Indiana Limestone, all acquired from Kocurek Industries (Caldwell, TX, USA). The dataset includes both raw and segmented images of the pore and grain space in addition to their size information.
dct_title_s: Characterization of Pore and Grain Size Distributions in Porous Geological Samples
